Character_Buster.description: Small young adult companion dog, compact toy-to-small terrier mix build, short smooth black-and-white coat with irregular patches, floppy dark ears, bright dark round eyes, black nose, pink-black tongue often visible, expressive posture; bare-fur default daytime look.
Character_Buster.voice_profile: Non-speaking animal; only natural small-dog sounds—happy pants, collar jingles, soft whines, sleepy sighs—light, quick, playful energy, never human words.
Character_Buster.visual_lock: Always the same small black-and-white short-coated dog: shape, floppy ears, bright dark eyes, patchy black-and-white markings that never recolor. Default continuity portrait is bare-fur short coat. Never redraw as a large breed, long-haired dog, or solid single color.
wardrobe_always: snug black-and-white dog pajama top and bottoms for bedtime/stairs/bed/dream chase beats — not base portrait

Character_Daddy.description: Human man in his late 30s to mid 40s, medium-tall build, fair-to-medium skin, short brown hair lightly greying at the temples, clean-shaven or very light stubble, tired eyes; simple soft pajama shirt as default home look.
Character_Daddy.voice_profile: No dialogue in this adaptation; presence only—occasional soft page-turn or mattress shift, low quiet room energy.
